# Funded Trading Rules Intelligence

> Independent, evidence-backed intelligence for proprietary trading firm rules, drawdown calculations, and payout policies. Every rule is verified with official contract citations and deterministic math.

## Website Overview
- Website: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com
- Primary Focus: Verified prop firm trading rules, daily loss limit mechanics, trailing vs static drawdown formulas, payout consistency conditions, news trading buffers, and hidden Gotchas.
- Coverage: 24+ top proprietary trading firms across Forex/CFD and CME/CBOT Futures venues.

  Browse 24+ evaluated and audited prop firms with full corporate dossiers, platforms, and rulebooks.

  Master reference manual covering 40+ operational rules, mathematical formulas, and violation failure points.

  Side-by-side comparison of rules, pricing, profit splits, and drawdowns between leading firms.

  Interactive tool to match your trading strategy (scalping, swing, EA, news) with the safest prop firm rulebooks.
- Drawdown Risk Simulator: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/simulator
  Deterministic simulation engine to stress-test your strategy against balance-based vs equity-based trailing drawdown rules.

## High-Intent Curated Directories
- Prop Firms with Static Drawdown: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-static-drawdown
  Firms where the maximum loss floor remains permanently fixed below the starting balance and never ratchets upward on profit.
- Prop Firms with Trailing Drawdown: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-trailing-drawdown
  Firms using End-of-Day (EOD) or intraday peak equity trailing locks.
- Prop Firms with Instant Funding: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-instant-funding
  Accounts with zero evaluation phases: direct access to funded capital and profit share from day one.

  Firms with unrestricted payouts, zero single-day profit caps, and no lot-size ratio constraints.
- Prop Firms with No Daily Loss Limit: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-no-daily-loss
  Firms that only enforce an overall maximum account loss, eliminating midnight equity reset breaches.
- Prop Firms Allowing News Trading: https://www.fundedtradingrules.com/prop-firms/with-news-trading
  Firms allowing trade execution during red-folder macroeconomic releases (CPI, NFP, FOMC) without 2-minute buffer bans.

## Critical Rule Mathematical Definitions
- Daily Loss Limit (Balance-Based): Loss Floor = Day-Start Balance - (Initial Balance * Daily Loss %). Open profits do not move the floor upward.
- Daily Loss Limit (Equity-Based): Loss Floor = Day-Start Equity - (Initial Balance * Daily Loss %). High floating intraday profits ratchet the floor up.
- Static Max Drawdown: Breach Floor = Initial Balance - (Initial Balance * Max Loss %). Permanent fixed level.
- Intraday Trailing Drawdown: Breach Floor = Highest Unrealized Peak Equity Reached - Max Loss Allowance.
- 1% Floating Loss Rule: Any single position reaching -1.00% unrealized loss relative to starting account nominal capital triggers an instantaneous termination.
